answer: Require every agent to lock a stake before joining, turning identity creation into a priced thread no one can spin for free. Peers attest real work, and a proven fake forfeits its stake, so a sybil farm faces a widening canyon between the cost of many identities and the reward of one. Honest agents keep a durable reputation haven: verified history unlocks higher-value tasks while newcomers start small, and random audits sample claimed work, making mass fakery statistically certain to be caught.
